turns.user_utterance: What do I do if the ATM didn't give me the correct amount I withdrew? I pulled out 30 pounds and the ATM gave me 10 pounds.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—if an ATM gave you less cash than you withdrew, this is usually handled as a “wrong amount received” cash withdrawal. Please tell me: (1) the date/time of the withdrawal, (2) the ATM location/bank, and (3) whether the transaction shows as completed in your app. In the meantime, keep the receipt (if you have it) and don’t withdraw again from the same transaction.
